Categorical codes follow insertion order rather than lexical order, so the physical codes run opposite to the alphabetical sort. I'm checking how the grades, loans and bands series map to those codes, and whether the asof join on the physical codes will come out sorted.

Working through the backward scan, the left key 4 matches against the right side and settles on "d", and the remaining left keys follow the same result, so all five rows come out "d" as expected. The forward scan finds nothing once the right keys drop below the left ones, leaving five nulls. Next I'm checking the streaming path, since it may use lexical comparisons to decide which right rows to keep.
